name: CSO_DB_METRICS
description: This table contains the metric information for discussion board.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: Datetime record was last modified in repository.

columns.name: DISCUSSION_BOARD_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the discussion board.

columns.name: FORUM_COUNT
columns.description: This is the current count of forums.

columns.name: LAST_POST_DATE
columns.description: This column is the last post datetime for this record.

columns.name: LAST_POST_MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the last posted message.

columns.name: LAST_POST_TOPIC_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the last posted topic

columns.name: LAST_POST_USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID reference to the user who last posted a message or topic

columns.name: LAST_POST_USER_NAME
columns.description: Full name of the user who last posted a message or topic.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the locale of the topic or message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_COUNT
columns.description: This is the current count of messages associated with this record.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: TOPIC_COUNT
columns.description: This is the current count of topics.

columns.name: VIEW_COUNT
columns.description: Thi sis the latest view count for object.

columns.name: LAST_POST_USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user who last posted a message or topic.
